name: English
notes: English is the source language. Keep message, term, and plural keys in English; translate only values. Empty or missing values fall back to English. Preserve placeholders such as {0}. Guide texts are terms: keep the **bold** and `key` markers, and write key names such as Shift or Enter as in their own terms.

messages.TXT, JSON, PDF, DOCX, PPTX, CSV, HTML, J: TXT, JSON, PDF, DOCX, PPTX, CSV, HTML, JS, SQL and XLSX · up to 100 MB per file
messages.Each attachment must be 100 MB or smalle: Each attachment must be 100 MB or smaller.
messages.Save this task before adding attachments: Save this task before adding attachments.
messages.The attachments folder must be a regular: The attachments folder must be a regular directory.
messages.Attachment path is outside the data fold: Attachment path is outside the data folder.
messages.The organization attachments folder must: The organization attachments folder must be a regular directory.
messages.The task attachments folder must be a re: The task attachments folder must be a regular directory.

terms.In **Settings → Task editor layout**, pr: In **Settings → Task editor layout**, press **Open form designer**: the task window appears over the blurred app, with the field list on the left and the properties of the selected item on the right.
terms.Drag fields from the list into the windo: Drag fields from the list into the window, or between sections, to add and reorder them; the built-in **Attachments** section can be positioned and resized the same way. With the keyboard, `Enter` adds the selected field, the arrow keys move it and `Delete` removes it.
terms.Drag a section with one to four columns: Drag a section with one to four columns from **Components**, or click it to add it. Rename sections, choose whether to show their name and split the window into up to three layout columns with proportional widths.
terms.Drag the edges of the window to set its: Drag the edges of the window to set its width and height, or keep **Automatic height (fits the content)**. The real window never exceeds the app window and scrolls when needed. `Ctrl+Z` and `Ctrl+Y` undo and redo.
terms.Fields left off the form keep their valu: Fields left off the form keep their values and the task list columns do not change. **Save** stores the form, together with any other settings changes still pending, and closes the designer; **Cancel** discards the designer changes. Layouts travel with settings exports and backups.
terms.Mark a field as **Required** in the fiel: Mark a field as **Required** in the field properties of the form designer, or in **Settings → Column management** for tasks and issues. **Sequence** is required by default.
terms.Required fields are checked when you sav: Required fields are checked when you save a task or an issue, but only when they are on the form: missing fields are highlighted with a message. **Bulk edit** never empties a required field; imports are not checked.
terms.Yes/no fields and values that are not en: Yes/no fields and values that are not entered in the editor, such as tags, successors or the incidents and problems linked automatically, cannot be required.
terms.A detected update appears in a persisten: A detected update appears in a persistent banner in every view. **View update** opens the update settings; dismissing the banner keeps a shortcut in the top bar. The same version stays dismissed for this session, while a newer version is announced again.
terms.check the metrics during the first 48 ho: check the metrics during the first 48 hours.
terms.OrbitKanban is a local workspace for tas: OrbitKanban is a local workspace for tasks, linked issues, milestones and kanban. Everything runs on your PC: no account, no cloud, no installation.
terms.The app is a single executable. The **da: The app is a single executable. The **data** folder next to it holds the archive, backups, languages and update history.
terms.No installation or administrator rights: No installation or administrator rights are needed. The first launch creates a demo organization that you can explore or clear.
terms.The first time, Windows SmartScreen may: The first time, Windows SmartScreen may warn about an unsigned app: choose **More info** and then **Run anyway**.
terms.To share the app, close it and copy the: To share the app, close it and copy the executable together with its **data** folder: the recipient gets the same organizations, themes and settings.
terms.Do not run two copies on the same data f: Do not run two copies on the same data folder at the same time.
terms.The sidebar holds the organization menu,: The sidebar holds the organization menu, the sections of the six view types, this **Guide** and **Settings**.
terms.The menu button **☰** at the left of the: The menu button **☰** at the left of the top bar, or `Ctrl+B`, folds the sidebar into a column of icons so the views get more space. Hover an icon to see its name; the building icon still switches organization. Press the button again to expand the sidebar; the choice is remembered.
terms.The top bar offers global search, undo a: The top bar offers global search, undo and redo, and the archive status. **Open data folder** at the bottom shows where your data lives.
terms.Rename, reorder, remove or add the secti: Rename, reorder, remove or add the sections of each organization in **Settings → Navigation**.
terms.Press `F1` at any time to open this guid: Press `F1` at any time to open this guide.
terms.The running app keeps the same taskbar i: The running app keeps the same taskbar icon as the portable launcher, so a pinned icon always starts the launcher.
terms.**Settings → App & updates → Create desk: **Settings → App & updates → Create desktop shortcut** creates a shortcut that you can pin. Recreate it if you move the portable folder, and remove old broken pins.
terms.Each organization is a separate workspac: Each organization is a separate workspace with its own data, settings, theme, language and logo.
terms.Choose the active organization from the: Choose the active organization from the sidebar menu. Each one keeps its own tasks, issues, saved views and settings.
terms.**Manage organizations** opens the setti: **Manage organizations** opens the settings where you can create or delete organizations. At least one must remain.
terms.Enter the name and the interface languag: Enter the name and the interface language. Optionally add a logo and tick **Include demo data** to start with sample content.
terms.The logo (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or BMP up: The logo (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or BMP up to 15 MB) is stored with the organization and generates a matching theme.
terms.Rename the organization and change or re: Rename the organization and change or remove its logo in **Settings → Identity**.
terms.While the app starts, the loading screen: While the app starts, the loading screen already uses the theme colors and the logo of the organization that opens first.
terms.The main list: one row per task, with it: The main list: one row per task, with its portal code, schedule, effort and the incidents and problems linked to it.
terms.**Portal code** identifies the task on i: **Portal code** identifies the task on its source platform, such as a ticket platform, and links issues to it.
terms.**Sequence** is assigned automatically b: **Sequence** is assigned automatically but can be edited by hand; duplicates are allowed.
terms.**Description** and **Notes** are rich t: **Description** and **Notes** are rich text with bold, italic, underline and lists.
terms.**Urgency** and **Status** use the optio: **Urgency** and **Status** use the options configured in the settings, in their order.
terms.**Effort** is entered in days and hours: **Effort** is entered in days and hours and stored in hours, using the hours per day of the organization.
terms.**Release date** schedules the task: the: **Release date** schedules the task: the same date always has the same color, in every view.
terms.**Incident** and **Problem** are filled: **Incident** and **Problem** are filled automatically from the linked issues with the same portal code.
terms.**New task** or `Ctrl+N` opens the edito: **New task** or `Ctrl+N` opens the editor. Double-click a row, or click its code, to edit it.
terms.By default, the editor shows properties: By default, the editor shows properties on the left and description and notes on the right.
terms.The icon next to the code opens the task: The icon next to the code opens the task on its platform, in your default browser. It appears when a **Link to platform** column has a value.
terms.The default order is by release date, as: The default order is by release date, ascending. Click a column header to sort; `Shift`+click adds further sort levels.
terms.Statuses and urgencies sort by their con: Statuses and urgencies sort by their configured order. Descriptions and notes cannot be sorted.
terms.The **Release** button restores the defa: The **Release** button restores the default order.
terms.Drag a row by the handle on its left, or: Drag a row by the handle on its left, or focus the handle and press `↑` or `↓`. Sequence numbers are updated and the list is sorted by sequence.
terms.The eye button hides a row from the list: The eye button hides a row from the list without deleting it. Tick **Hidden** to show hidden rows again.
terms.Hidden tasks still appear in the milesto: Hidden tasks still appear in the milestones and in the kanban, marked **Hidden in list**.
terms.Narrow the list down in seconds and save: Narrow the list down in seconds and save the combinations you use most.
terms.The search box looks for codes, descript: The search box looks for codes, descriptions, incidents and other text. Next to it you can filter by status and highlight, and show hidden rows or duplicates.
Every column header has a filter button. Text columns use **Contains**; numbers and effort use a **From**/**To** range.
terms.Date filters list **Unassigned** and eve: Date filters list **Unassigned** and every date in use, each with its color and number of rows. You can also choose a **From**/**To** range.
terms.Statuses, urgencies, highlights, tags an: Statuses, urgencies, highlights, tags and choice columns filter by one or more values. Every column can also show only empty or only filled cells.
terms.Filters on different columns combine: a: Filters on different columns combine: a row must match all of them. The bar above the table summarizes them and removes them one by one.
terms.**Views** saves the current search, filt: **Views** saves the current search, filters, sorting and columns under a name, up to 30 per organization. Pick a view from the menu to apply it.
terms.A view for every release date is created: A view for every release date is created automatically, under **Upcoming releases** and **Past releases**.
terms.`Ctrl+K` or the search button in the top: `Ctrl+K` or the search button in the top bar finds tasks and issues by code, incident, problem or release date. `Enter` opens the first result.
terms.Make important rows stand out and group: Make important rows stand out and group tasks with your own labels.
terms.Turn on the star of a status in its labe: Turn on the star of a status in its label settings: every task in that status is highlighted automatically.
terms.Pick a color in the highlighter bar, the: Pick a color in the highlighter bar, then click rows to color them; click again to remove the color. The **Eraser** clears highlights and `Esc` stops.
terms.The ● button at the end of each row and: The ● button at the end of each row and the task editor set the highlight too. The highlight filter shows highlighted rows, rows without highlight or a single color.
terms.Names, colors and order of up to 16 high: Names, colors and order of up to 16 highlighters are managed in the settings.
terms.Tags are a catalog of up to 100 colored: Tags are a catalog of up to 100 colored labels, with names up to 60 characters.
terms.Assign several tags to a task from its t: Assign several tags to a task from its tags cell in the list, then press **Apply**. Bulk edit adds or removes tags on many tasks at once.
terms.Change many tasks at once and step back: Change many tasks at once and step back when something goes wrong.
Tick the boxes on the left of the rows. `Shift`+click selects a range; the box in the header selects every task shown.
terms.The selection survives searches, filters: The selection survives searches, filters and sorting. **Deselect** or `Esc` clears it.
terms.**Bulk edit** lists the selected tasks a: **Bulk edit** lists the selected tasks and the fields to change. Every field starts as **Keep unchanged**.
terms.You can change every field of the editor: You can change every field of the editor: portal code, status, urgency, highlight, effort, visibility, release date (set, shift or remove), description and notes (replace, add at the end or clear), custom columns, tags and groups. **Sequence** can be renumbered in list order.
terms.**Delete…** removes the ticked tasks aft: **Delete…** removes the ticked tasks after a confirmation. In the milestones, the pencil of each release opens bulk edit for its tasks.
terms.`Ctrl+Z` undoes the last change; `Ctrl+Y: `Ctrl+Z` undoes the last change; `Ctrl+Y` or `Ctrl+Shift+Z` redoes it, up to 20 operations per organization. The arrows in the top bar do the same.
terms.Undo is paused while the settings have u: Undo is paused while the settings have unsaved changes.
terms.Spot an incident linked twice before it: Spot an incident linked twice before it causes confusion.
terms.An incident linked to more than one task: An incident linked to more than one task, or used in more than one association, is flagged in amber. Point at it to see where else it is used.
terms.The counters next to the views in the si: The counters next to the views in the sidebar show how many tasks and associations are involved.
terms.Tick **Duplicates** to show only the row: Tick **Duplicates** to show only the rows involved, hidden ones included. Editors warn you while you type.
terms.Associations with the same code, inciden: Associations with the same code, incident and problem are marked as identical: **Remove identical** deletes the copies and keeps the first one.
terms.Associate each portal code with its inci: Associate each portal code with its incidents and problems: the task list picks them up automatically.
terms.Each row links a portal code to an incid: Each row links a portal code to an incident, a problem or both. A problem can have several incidents, and a code can appear in several rows.
terms.Codes match the task list regardless of: Codes match the task list regardless of letter case and surrounding spaces. No connection to the ticket platform is needed.
terms.The linked column counts the tasks with: The linked column counts the tasks with that code; **Waiting for a task** means that no task uses it yet.
terms.**New association** adds a row; double-c: **New association** adds a row; double-click a row to edit it. Search, column filters, **Columns** and **Import CSV** work as in the task list.
terms.A roadmap built from the release dates,: A roadmap built from the release dates, always up to date with the task list.
terms.Each release date becomes a milestone wi: Each release date becomes a milestone with all its tasks, in date order. Scroll horizontally through the releases and vertically through the tasks.
terms.Colors match the release dates of the li: Colors match the release dates of the list. Tasks without a date are grouped at the end as **Unscheduled**.
terms.Hidden tasks are included, with a dashed: Hidden tasks are included, with a dashed border and the **Hidden in list** label. Click the code on a card to edit the task.
terms.The first release from today onwards is: The first release from today onwards is highlighted as **Next release**, or **Today's release**. The button in the header brings it back into view.
terms.The highlight follows the date of your P: The highlight follows the date of your PC and moves on by itself after midnight.
terms.The pencil of each milestone opens bulk: The pencil of each milestone opens bulk edit for all its tasks, for example to move the release to another date.
terms.A read-only board that shows where every: A read-only board that shows where every task stands.
terms.There is one column per status, in the o: There is one column per status, in the order set in the settings. Tasks without a status appear under **Unassigned**.
terms.Cards show code and description; hidden: Cards show code and description; hidden tasks are included and marked.
terms.To move a card, change the status of the: To move a card, change the status of the task in the list or in its editor.
terms.Decide which columns each list shows and: Decide which columns each list shows and add the fields your team needs.
terms.**Columns** above each list, or **Settin: **Columns** above each list, or **Settings → List columns**, shows or hides columns and changes their order by dragging. Hiding a column never deletes data.
terms.**Highlight** is available but hidden at: **Highlight** is available but hidden at first. **Restore default columns** brings back the initial layout.
terms.In **Settings → Column management** you: In **Settings → Column management** you can add up to 40 columns per list: text, rich text, number, date, single or multiple choice, website, link to platform, effort in hours, yes/no and, in the task list, references between tasks.
terms.The type cannot be changed after creatio: The type cannot be changed after creation. Custom columns can be filtered, imported from CSV and exported to Excel; numbers, dates, effort, yes/no and single choices can also be sorted.
terms.Default columns can be deleted too, and: Default columns can be deleted too, and restored later without their old values. Settings that depend on a column appear only while it exists.
terms.Without **Release date** there are no mi: Without **Release date** there are no milestones or release views, without **Status** there is no kanban, and without **Sequence** rows cannot be dragged.
terms.Statuses, urgencies, highlights, tags an: Statuses, urgencies, highlights, tags and every choice column share the same label editor: name, color, order, add and delete.
terms.Deleting an option in use and saving lea: Deleting an option in use and saving leaves the affected tasks unassigned.
terms.Make the workspace yours: every change i: Make the workspace yours: every change is previewed live and kept when you save.
terms.Choose from 40 built-in themes, 27 dark: Choose from 40 built-in themes, 27 dark and 13 light, or create your own from four colors: background, surface, text and accent.
terms.Built-in themes can be edited for each o: Built-in themes can be edited for each organization and brought back with **Restore built-in theme**; your own themes can be edited and deleted.
terms.Built-in palettes meet WCAG AA contrast:: Built-in palettes meet WCAG AA contrast: text at least 4.5:1 and accent at least 3:1, on both background and surfaces.
terms.The app icon takes the theme colors too,: The app icon takes the theme colors too, like themed icons on a phone: in the sidebar, in the browser tab and on the app window in the taskbar. The executable file and pinned shortcuts keep the original icon.
terms.Upload an image and all four colors are: Upload an image and all four colors are extracted automatically, then adjusted as little as possible, in lightness only, to meet WCAG AA.
terms.You can also pick a role and click the i: You can also pick a role and click the image to sample its color. Images are processed in memory, never saved or sent.
terms.Every color uses the built-in picker: dr: Every color uses the built-in picker: drag in the color area, use the hue, saturation and lightness sliders, or type a HEX code.
terms.`Enter` or **Apply** confirms; `Esc` or: `Enter` or **Apply** confirms; `Esc` or **Cancel** restores the previous color.
terms.Choose from 33 fonts: 24 included and av: Choose from 33 fonts: 24 included and available offline, such as Roboto and Inter, and 9 system fonts, such as Segoe UI and Aptos.
terms.Scale seven parts of the interface separ: Scale seven parts of the interface separately, or use the **Compact**, **Standard**, **Large** and **Extra large** presets.
terms.Each organization has its own configurat: Each organization has its own configuration, organized in tabs.
terms.Changes take effect only with **Save set: Changes take effect only with **Save settings**. A banner lists the modified tabs and a dot marks each of them.
terms.**Discard changes**, or leaving the sett: **Discard changes**, or leaving the settings without saving, keeps the previous configuration.
terms.Set the organization name and the hours: Set the organization name and the hours of an effort day. Changing the hours per day changes only how effort is displayed.
terms.Italian and English are built in, and th: Italian and English are built in, and the language is chosen for each organization.
terms.To add a language, translate a copy of `: To add a language, translate a copy of `en.template.json` in the `data/languages` folder and press **Reload languages**. Invalid files are listed and ignored.
terms.Your data is a portable JSON archive, pr: Your data is a portable JSON archive, protected by automatic copies and easy to move.
terms.Everything is saved in `data/workspace.j: Everything is saved in `data/workspace.json`, with the previous save in `workspace.json.bak`.
terms.Before the first change of each day a ba: Before the first change of each day a backup is stored in `data/backups`, and the last 14 are kept. **Settings → Data that travels with you** lists them and restores one after a confirmation.
terms.**Export backup** and **Import backup**: **Export backup** and **Import backup** save or replace the whole archive, all organizations included.
terms.Export the themes, the settings, the dat: Export the themes, the settings, the data or everything of the active organization.
terms.When importing, check the preview, then: When importing, check the preview, then add and update or replace everything, in this organization or in a new one. Statuses and urgencies are matched by name.
terms.**Import CSV**, in both lists, adds rows: **Import CSV**, in both lists, adds rows from a .csv or .tsv file of up to 16 MB, 100 columns and 10,000 rows.
terms.Check separator, encoding and header row: Check separator, encoding and header row, map each column to a field and review the preview. Nothing is saved until every error is fixed.
terms.Dates use YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY and m: Dates use YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY and multiple values are separated by `|`. The whole import can be undone with `Ctrl+Z`.
terms.The **Excel** button of every view expor: The **Excel** button of every view exports the current situation to an .xlsx workbook with summary, tasks, issues, milestones and kanban sheets.
terms.Choose the tasks (as shown, all or selec: Choose the tasks (as shown, all or selected), the columns and the sheets. Colors, links and real dates are kept.
terms.**Clear tasks and issues** deletes all t: **Clear tasks and issues** deletes all the tasks and associations of the organization, keeping settings and themes.
terms.While the app is open, you can also work: While the app is open, you can also work from a browser on the same PC.
terms.**Open in browser** opens the active org: **Open in browser** opens the active organization in your default browser; other organizations can be opened in separate tabs.
terms.**Copy access link** copies a private li: **Copy access link** copies a private link for this PC. The link contains a key: do not share it.
terms.Changes sync in real time between the ap: Changes sync in real time between the app and every tab, with protection against conflicting edits.
terms.When the app is closed, tabs show **App: When the app is closed, tabs show **App not reachable** and reconnect once it is open again. Updates are installed only from the desktop app.
terms.New versions are published on GitHub, an: New versions are published on GitHub, and installing one always requires your confirmation.
terms.In **Settings → App & updates** press **: In **Settings → App & updates** press **Check for updates**, or let the app check at startup.
terms.**Download update** downloads the new ve: **Download update** downloads the new version and verifies its SHA-256 checksum; **Install and restart** replaces the executable and reopens the app.
terms.The data folder stays where it is. Befor: The data folder stays where it is. Before installing, the previous executable and a copy of the archive are saved in `data/updates`.
terms.Only the version is checked: GitHub rece: Only the version is checked: GitHub receives no workspace data.
terms.Work faster without leaving the keyboard: Work faster without leaving the keyboard.
terms.Create a task from the task list: Create a task from the task list
terms.Close a dialog, cancel a drag, stop the: Close a dialog, cancel a drag, stop the highlighter or clear the selection
terms.Sort by more columns, or select a range: Sort by more columns, or select a range of tasks
terms.Edit a task or an association: Edit a task or an association
terms.Move a row or an option from its drag ha: Move a row or an option from its drag handle
terms.Open the first result of the global sear: Open the first result of the global search, or apply a color
terms.Everything OrbitKanban can do, explained: Everything OrbitKanban can do, explained step by step.
terms.Open tasks on the platforms where they l: Open tasks on the platforms where they live, collect useful websites and connect tasks that depend on each other.
terms.A **Link to platform** column opens the: A **Link to platform** column opens the task on an external platform, such as a ticket platform or a change platform. Add one column for each platform in **Settings → Column management** and fill in only the ones a task needs.
terms.Each column has its own **Link template*: Each column has its own **Link template**, with `{code}` where the code goes, for example `https://tickets.example.com/browse/{code}`. In the task you then enter only the code, or copy the task code with one click; a full address entered in a task replaces the template for that task.
terms.Without a template, enter the full addre: Without a template, enter the full address in each task. A preview under the field shows the resulting link.
terms.The icon next to the task code, on the c: The icon next to the task code, on the cards and in Excel exports opens the first platform link that has a value, in the order of the list columns, even when its column is hidden.
terms.The single portal link of earlier versio: The single portal link of earlier versions becomes a **Link to platform** column automatically, with the same template and the same links.
terms.A **Website** column holds any web addre: A **Website** column holds any web address, such as documentation or a shared folder, and shows it as a link that opens in your default browser.
terms.A **Reference parent** column lists the: A **Reference parent** column lists the tasks that come before a task. Adding it to the task list also adds its **Reference child** column, named **Successors** unless you choose another name.
terms.In the editor, **Choose predecessors** o: In the editor, **Choose predecessors** opens a searchable list of the other tasks. The task then appears automatically among the successors of each task you choose.
terms.Successors are read-only: to change them: Successors are read-only: to change them, edit the predecessors of the other task. A task cannot depend on itself or on its own successors, so chains never loop.
terms.Click a reference to open that task. Del: Click a reference to open that task. Deleting a task removes it from every reference, and deleting either column deletes both.
terms.In **Settings → Navigation** choose the: In **Settings → Navigation** choose the sections of the sidebar: drag them or use the arrows to change their order, rename them, remove them or add new ones, up to 12.
terms.Each section opens one of six types: tas: Each section opens one of six types: tasks, linked issues, milestones, kanban, views or group activities. A type can have several sections, and a type without sections leaves the menu. **Guide** and **Settings** always stay at the bottom.
terms.The **Views** section lists all saved vi: The **Views** section lists all saved views and automatic release views. Open one to apply it to the task list, even if its menu section was removed. Release views include hidden tasks.
terms.Link a saved view to a task, milestone o: Link a saved view to a task, milestone or kanban section to show only its tasks, for example a board for one team. A task section applies its view when you open it; deleting the saved view brings back every task.
terms.Removing a section never deletes data. T: Removing a section never deletes data. The first section opens when the app starts.
terms.Every change to the checkout flow and to: Every change to the checkout flow and to the payment providers.
terms.work planned for the next store releases: work planned for the next store releases.
terms.Login, single sign-on and user managemen: Login, single sign-on and user management, reviewed together by the security team.
terms.Collect related tasks under a name and a: Collect related tasks under a name and a description, and follow their progress together.
terms.Incidents and problems come from the ass: Incidents and problems come from the associations and successors from the predecessor columns, so they are not edited here. Required fields cannot be emptied.
terms.**New group** asks for a name, a color a: **New group** asks for a name, a color and a rich text description, then lets you tick the tasks that belong to it. Search and **Selected only** help with long lists.
terms.A task can belong to several groups and: A task can belong to several groups and a group can stay empty. Group names must be unique in the organization.
terms.Each card shows the description, the num: Each card shows the description, the number of tasks, the total effort, the release dates and a bar with the tasks of each status.
terms.Click a task to edit it. The **Groups**: Click a task to edit it. The **Groups** menu at the top of the task editor changes the groups of that task.
terms.The task editor includes an **Attachment: The task editor includes an **Attachments** section with a drop zone and file picker. The paperclip on a task row opens the same list. Drop or choose TXT, JSON, PDF, DOCX, PPTX, CSV, HTML, JS, SQL or XLSX files (up to 100 MB each). Click a file to open it with the system default app.
terms.Save a new task before adding attachment: Save a new task before adding attachments.
terms.Attachments are copied into `data/attach: Attachments are copied into `data/attachments`, in a folder named after the task code. The app scans that folder when you open it, so files removed outside the app disappear from the list.
terms.Use the trash icon to delete a file perm: Use the trash icon to delete a file permanently after confirming.
terms.The **Bulk edit** button of a card chang: The **Bulk edit** button of a card changes every task of the group, hidden ones included. Deleting a group keeps its tasks.
